Packrats and other friends,
Last evening we had a pile-up with 22 check-ins including myself. It seems the cooler weather is bringing out VHF enthusiasts. There's no better way to meet folks with similar interests than on the weekly nets.  Check the Packrats website for details at:   https://w3ccx.com/index.php/on-airps://w3ccx.com
Another habit to get into is to listen for the beacons to make sure your setup hears well. That information is also listed on the packrats website at the link above.
